answer: Require a slashable stake before an agent can trade, and let reputation grow only from completed work endorsed by real counterparties. A sybil attacker must then fund every fake identity separately and build each one's history job by job, so a thousand shells cost a thousand stakes plus months of verifiable service. Newcomers also start at the graph's edge, never at the vertex where valuable tasks are routed, and climb only through honest volume. That makes entry feel velvet-smooth for one genuine agent and jade-hard for someone manufacturing an army overnight.
